reason: A DSH sound customization plugin that configures event-triggered playback, manages a local audio library, and optionally generates voice clips through Alibaba Cloud Bailian TTS.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 界面事件配置提示音、管理本地音频库，并可使用用户提供的阿里云百炼凭证生成语音片段。
summaries.en: Configure sounds for DSH interface events, manage a local audio library, and optionally generate voice clips with user-provided Alibaba Cloud Bailian credentials.

capabilities: plays configurable audio for four DSH interface events
reads and writes plugin-local audio files and configuration
uploads, deletes, renames, and restores local sound-library entries
calls Alibaba Cloud Bailian text-to-speech using a user-provided API key and voice ID
